title: Isolation and Stacking Context Control knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Isolation and Stacking Context Control?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
choose utilities that express the intended layout, constraints and responsive changes
questions.answer_key: choose utilities that express the intended layout, constraints and responsive changes
questions.explanation: Isolation and Stacking Context Control is best understood through the syllabus topics: Understanding isolation, Creating independent stacking contexts, Managing layered interface components. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with isolation and stacking context control?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
test a narrow viewport, a wide viewport and overflowing content
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: test a narrow viewport, a wide viewport and overflowing content
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Understanding isolation, Creating independent stacking contexts, Managing layered interface components, Avoiding unintended overlap.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying isolation and stacking context control?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a desktop-only screenshot is not enough evidence of a responsive layout
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: a desktop-only screenshot is not enough evidence of a responsive layout
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
